_note: REAL candidates. Chosen by a fixed rule (below), approved by md on 2026-11-21. Party is display only; no code reads it. Results are AP calls, not yet certified: re-check against each state's certified canvass before the demo.

selection_rule.pool: All 36 governor races, filtered to those where at least 2 different national news outlets covered data centers as an issue in that race before 2026-11-03. Local editions of national brands and policy-firm trackers do not count.
selection_rule.pick: The 3 races with the closest margin between the top two candidates, both candidates in each race.
selection_rule.sources_rule: For every candidate: the Internet Archive capture of the campaign site closest to 2026-11-02, plus the site's news or media page if it has one, plus the official YouTube channel if found (link-only, added by manual CSV).

selection_log.why: only state/local coverage found in 2 searches on 2026-11-21
one national outlet found (Newsweek); others local
4th closest qualifying-candidate margin; would replace New Hampshire only if certified margins reorder them

selected_by: md (rule proposed by md's Claude, approved by md)
known_coverage_gaps: Florida: no general-election debate (first since 1974); the candidates spoke separately at WLRN's Sunshine Economy Summit on 2026-09-23.
Kansas: one debate (Kansas State Fair, 2026-09-12); Masterson declined TV debates on 2026-09-24 and 2026-10-01.
New Hampshire: one NHPR / Granite State News Collaborative forum, 2026-10-22.

channel_search.method: A channel counts as official only if it uploaded videos embedded on the candidate's own campaign site (uploader read from YouTube's public oEmbed endpoint), or is linked from that site.

found.david-jolly: @DavidJollyFL (uploader of 15 videos embedded on davidjolly.com; his own channel, which may predate the campaign: only videos in the campaign period count)
found.cinde-warmington: @CindeWarmingtonNH (linked in site footer; uploader of her embedded videos)

not_found.ty-masterson: No videos embedded or linked on mastersonforgovernor.com; YouTube search results were re-uploads (unofficial channel 'kansaspolitics') or TV stations.
not_found.byron-donalds: No videos embedded or linked on byrondonalds.com (only a background header video); YouTube search results were TV stations and Forbes Breaking News.

broadcaster_search.decided_by: md, 2026-11-21: add TV and news footage for all six, to fill the gap where two campaigns publish no videos
broadcaster_search.queries: Exactly two web searches per candidate, restricted to youtube.com: '<full name> governor interview' and '<full name> governor debate'.
broadcaster_search.assignment: A video is assigned to every candidate whose surname is in its title (so a debate goes to both).
broadcaster_search.uploader_rule: Keep only uploads by news organizations (TV stations, networks, newspapers, Bloomberg, Forbes), identified by YouTube oEmbed author. Exclude independent creators and talk/opinion shows on every side, re-uploaders of ads, and unavailable videos.
broadcaster_search.then: Rows go to data/ingest/manual_rows.csv. A person fills date, venue, duration; import applies the campaign period and the same 12-video cap (newest first) across campaign and broadcaster videos together.
